checkpoints.description: [1/1] Split the shared two-dot eye motif into six archetype motifs (pair, slits, single, many, hollow, glare) behind an _enemy_eyes helper, and assigned motifs to fifteen enemies so families stop reading as the same blob: hollow for shadow and forgotten, single cyclops for voidWalker, bogLeech and leviathan, triple for prismEntity, voidCantor, hiveDrone, hiveGuard, mireSovereign, slit visors for solderWisp, plagueCaster, catacombArcher, angled glare for spirit and graveHound. All 35 enemy sheets reviewed before and after, in-game biome sweep with zero console errors, 151 tests and 8/8 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'art-eyes-v1' completed successfully.

[1/1] Added three variants each for the four floor deco kinds (crack, rubble, moss, glyph) and picked one per tile from the stable tile hash, so a floor of cracks no longer reads as a single stamped pattern. Cracks get three different origins and a spur variant, glyphs get a circle ward, a four-point ward and concentric arcs, moss gets a creeping-corner variant, rubble a chunkier one. Typecheck, lint, 151 tests and 8/8 gates pass; two biome captures reviewed with zero console errors. checklists: passed
Task 'art-deco-v1' completed successfully.

[1/1] Added deterministic view-only room dressing: one or two small wall-base props per dungeon room, per-biome from existing atlas props (barrel, crate, bone pile, herbs, lantern, brazier, coral, comb, candle). Placement is seeded from the room rectangle, skips doorways and glyphs, never touches the simulation, and is disabled in Sanctuary interiors. Verified in ruins and catacombs with zero console errors; typecheck, lint, 151 tests and 8/8 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'art-dressing-v1' completed successfully.

[1/1] Rebuilt the final boss renderer: the Keeper was a flat tan trapezoid with a stick staff at 192px. It now has a double-ring radiant halo with a crown of rays, a layered robe with lit inner stole, hem band and gold sashes, a shoulder mantle with a lit edge, crossed sleeves with gold cuffs, a shadowed hood with a gold circlet and glaring eyes, a tall crozier with a spiral head and a floating memory gem, and drifting blessing motes. Also audited live effect layers: telegraphs, projectile glows, hit flash, damage numbers and the lever prompt all render correctly, and confirmed the runtime particle system is procedural (fxArt.ts) while sprites/particles and two UI icons are unused legacy. Verified in the live Keeper fight with zero console errors; 151 tests and 8/8 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'art-keeper-v1' completed successfully.

[1/1] Rebuilt the Bone Tyrant: tattered ragged-hem cloak, layered spiked bone pauldrons, ribbed breastplate with sternum jewel, skull with heavy jaw, teeth, hollow sockets and a five-spike crown with gem, plus a shortened great cleaver that no longer clips the frame. Gave the Void Cantor a dedicated cantor archetype instead of reusing the small hunched body at scale 1.0: hovering choral robe fraying into ribbons, shoulder cowl with stole ends, deep hood with three eyes and a singing mouth, conducting arms with bony fingers and orbiting hymn glyphs. Also mapped all 52 enemy sprite keys and found 17 late enemies still borrow older sheets with only a tint (documented as intentional). Bone Tyrant verified in the live catacombs fight; Void Cantor sheet reviewed and its key mapping confirmed (void_cantor and void_herald both resolve to voidCantor); zero console errors; 151 tests and 8/8 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'art-bosses2-v1' completed successfully.

[1/1] Gave six late-section enemies dedicated sheets instead of borrowed art plus a tint: new oracle archetype (hovering seer with scrying orb) for tide_caller and frost_oracle, new herald archetype (banner-bearing wraith) for ash_herald, new witch archetype (petal gown, pointed hat, blossom staff) for petal_witch, and dedicated hound sheets for magma_hound and cinder_hound. Enemy style count rose 35 to 41 and the sprite keys now point at the new sheets; the redundant ENEMY_TINTS entries were removed so each carries its section colour in the art. Reviewed the six previews at 2x, ran a full biome capture with zero console errors, 151 tests and 8/8 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'art-late-mobs-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: add per-biome ambient particle layers, render them through Effects, cover the profile table with unit tests, then verify all 14 biomes in the browser

impact_assessment.why: Every room shares one faint accent-tinted dust field, so the fourteen biomes read as the same air and the title backdrop has little motion.
impact_assessment.benefits: Each biome gets its own layered atmosphere - dust, spores, embers, ash, snow, petals, bubbles, fireflies or drifting void - using pooled sprites with no gameplay or save impact.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new view module and a changed Effects constructor; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: runtime-only, no persisted data; perf: about fifty extra pooled sprites.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate every biome profile in a unit test, cap counts, reuse one sprite pool, render a 14-biome screenshot sweep, and run test, lint, typecheck and build.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented the per-biome atmosphere profiles, four new particle textures, the pooled Effects field, the atmosphere unit test, and the README, Graphics, Architecture and ADR documentation

[3/3] Phase 4 green: 154 tests, lint, typecheck, build, mechanics and all 8 gates pass; 16-section Playwright sweep shows 32-48 motes per biome with the expected textures and motions and zero console errors; headless software rendering loses about 1.5 fps with the field on. checklists: passed
Task 'art-atmosphere-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: replace the player's four-point scarf with a tapered two-tail ribbon, animate hem and idle breathing, regenerate the sheets, then verify idle, walk, attack and dash at 8x and in play

impact_assessment.why: The Memory Walker's scarf is a short zigzag that reads as a cyan checkmark in every frame, and the cloak hem is static, so the character who is on screen constantly has little cloth motion.
impact_assessment.benefits: A tapered two-tail ribbon with per-frame sway, a hem trim and a breathing bob gives the hero a readable cloth silhouette and more life at gameplay scale.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; art: deterministic player sheets only, atlas keys and frame sizes stay the same.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the generator deterministic, inspect all four states at 8x, reload a live run for an in-game check, and rerun tests, typecheck, build and the eight gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Reworked the hero scarf generator into a tapered two-tail ribbon with state paths, a lit top edge, an under-tail, a soft glow and a shoulder clasp; added hem sway and breathing bob, regenerated all ten player sheets, and updated Graphics and ADR-039

[3/3] Phase 4 green: 154 tests, lint, typecheck, build, mechanics and all 8 gates pass; all ten player sheets regenerated and only the player PNGs changed; idle, walk, attack, spear and greatsword reviewed at 10x and a fresh ruins run shows the two-tail scarf with zero console errors. checklists: passed
Task 'art-hero-scarf-v2' completed successfully.
